notes: Employees: approximate head count at 31 December 2025, stated in thousands (869.6 thousand) in the MD&A. Payroll: the 'increase during the year' column of the employee-benefits note is the total employee remuneration BYD accrued in 2025 (salaries, bonuses, allowances and subsidies 100,087,341; social insurance 6,182,948; housing fund 4,088,298; retirement contributions 14,490,065; other items), RMB 128,190,527 thousand. It is consistent with the MD&A statement that total staff cost was about 15.94% of turnover. The cash flow statement separately shows 'Cash paid to and on behalf of employees' of RMB 130,434,959 thousand. As a non-SEC issuer BYD has no CEO pay ratio disclosure.
